MESSAGE: read the instructions below for keybinds, practise moving for a bit. go on, practise. now, you have two weapons - a bow [1] and a sword [2] use your sword to kill the smaller eyes and use your bow for ranged attack on the larger eye. it'll make sence when you press start and spawn him,...

, after you've spawned him, attack him while dodging his attacks, you may die a few times. when he gets to lower health, he will shed his iris and show his mouth, here, he'll do more damage and be much faster. focus more on dodging. goodluck.
